npm --prefix src/engine test — 1638 passed, 1 failed (vitest). The one failure:

Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
If this is a long-running test, pass a timeout value as the last argument or configure it globally with "testTimeout".
 ❯ scripts/verify-release.test.ts:252:3
    250|   });
    251|
    252|   it("reports an unreachable registry as unknown, never as publishable…
       |   ^
    253|     const { code, output } = registryGuard(
    254|       { NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: "not-a-real-token" },

Reproduced 3 times, identically (full suite twice, isolated once). `git diff --stat main -- scripts/verify-release.test.ts` shows zero diff — this file is completely untouched by the W111 change set. The test tries to reach https://registry.invalid.subzerodev.test and detect it as unreachable within 5000ms; in this environment the DNS/network timeout for that lookup does not resolve inside the test's timeout window. Pre-existing, environment-dependent, unrelated to this slice's collection-condition changes.

gates.name: Build documentation
gates.reason: ./docs.ps1 does not exist in this checkout. Per CLAUDE.md ("Tooling" § Docs Site), docs.ps1 is installed by Invoke-SetupDocs and is not committed to the repository, so it is only present in an environment where that installer has already been run. Docker itself is available (`docker info` succeeded), but the script this gate invokes is not. The corresponding CI check ("Verify Documentation Build") on the pull request is where this must be confirmed.

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.reason: npm --prefix site run merge writes the landing build into artifacts/docs, which must come from a fresh 'Build documentation' run — that gate did not run (see above), so there is no current docs build to merge into. A stale artifacts/docs/ directory exists on disk (gitignored, last modified 2026-08-30, from an unrelated earlier session) but merging into stale, non-current output would not be a genuine local reproduction of this gate and was not used.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: Requires building the Docker host image first (.github/workflows/host-image.yml), which restores SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from GitHub Packages in the sibling SubZeroDev.Platform repository using the REGISTRY_TOKEN secret (a cross-repo read:packages credential; the default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read it, and the workflow itself fails loudly rather than attempt an unauthenticated restore). That secret is not available in this local environment. Docker itself is available (`docker info` succeeded). The corresponding CI job ("Platform Static Host Image" / smoke) on the pull request is where this must be confirmed.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: Builds tools/host-smoke/Dockerfile.negative-fixture FROM the image built in the 'Positive route and probe smoke' step, which did not run for the same REGISTRY_TOKEN reason above — there is no local base image to build this fixture from. The corresponding CI job is where this must be confirmed.
